#.label: Checkout App: Mobile POS sales flow
#.description: Split proposal C: mixed (HRP-727). Holds the settings of one touchpoint. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-mpos-flow-editor.
#/properties/receipt.label: Receipt
#/properties/receipt/properties/clearTim: The duration for which the receipt remains visible after finalization. In milliseconds.
#/properties/receipt/properties/displayI: Defines whether voided items should be rendered on the Active Receipt.
#/properties/receipt/properties/layout.d: This is a definition of the receipt layout settings.
#/properties/receipt/properties/layout/p: The type of the identifier to be displayed in the receipt.
Toggles visibility of the listed item attributes in the receipt.
#/properties/receipt/properties/linkedPr: Enables visual linking of related promotion items with color bars in the active receipt view.
#/properties/receipt/properties/roundedA: When true, the app displays the rounded amount due.
#/properties/lock.label: Lock
#/properties/lock/properties/timeout.des: The number of seconds the register is idle before it is auto-locked.
#/properties/transactions.label: Transactions
#/properties/transactions.description: The configuration point to determine whether a customer's specific order numbers are handled by an external or internal repository.
#/properties/transactions/properties/aut: The authorization provider used for transaction lookups. Default: iam.
#/properties/transactions/properties/int: Defines how internal transaction numbers (RegularOrder) should be detected.
Regular expression used to detect internal transaction numbers (RegularOrder).
#/properties/transactions/properties/ext: Defines how external customer order numbers (ExternalCustomerOrder) should be detected.
When enabled, transaction numbers matching the external pattern will be treated as external.
Regular expression for external transaction numbers. Write it as a JSON string with escaped backslashes (e.g. \d{6}), without leading/trailing slashes.
#/properties/transactions/properties/act: Controls which actions are available on the transaction search details view (refund, complaint, print copy, print gift receipt). Choose "None" to use the defaults.
#/properties/prompt.label: Prompt
#/properties/prompt.description: This is a definition of the prompt settings mobile pos.
#/properties/prompt/properties/keyboardO: Defines specific prompt codes that override the default keyboard type.
Specifies the keyboard type override for the corresponding prompt code.
#/properties/plu.label: PLU
#/properties/b2bCustomer.label: B 2b customer
#/properties/b2bCustomer.description: B2B customer settings in MPOS mode.
#/properties/b2bCustomer/properties/sear: Automatically advances through the Customer, Project, Agent sequence and auto-submits once nothing else is required.
Includes inactive customers in B2B customer searches.
#/properties/b2bCustomer/properties/invo: Invoice settlement settings in MPOS mode.
The ID of the virtual item to be registered with the invoice.
#/properties/customerOrder.label: Customer Order Settings
#/properties/customerOrder.description: Customer order settings. Choose "None" to disable, or configure search/cancel/create behavior.
#/properties/customerOrder/properties/se: Enables the customer order search functionality in the POS.
#/properties/customerOrder/properties/ca: Allows canceling customer orders from the POS.
#/properties/customerOrder/properties/en: Allows creating customer orders from the POS.
